what: Phase C environment deviation: scipy added to the dolfinx spike env
why: the explicit neighbour-weight filter needs a neighbour search and Task 3 needs L-BFGS-B; both are scipy. Coordinator decision 2026-08-02.
incident: pip install scipy==1.14.1 SILENTLY DOWNGRADED numpy 2.4.6 -> 2.2.6, which is the numpy 2.2.x line the project handoff flags for a buffer-elision bug. Caught immediately, reverted, and scipy>=1.16 installed instead so numpy stays at 2.4.6. Recorded because a successor pinning scipy 1.14 would hit the same trap.

regression_check.gate: Phase B layer B2 FD gate, re-run after the change
regression_check.interpretation: the two DIRECTION probes reduce over ~10k entries, so summation order can differ across a rebuilt numpy; the two SINGLE-CELL probes are bit-identical. The moved quantities are themselves ~1e-7 and ~1e-10, orders below the 1e-6 gate, and every verdict is unchanged. This is the BLAS-noise class S1 recorded, which is why reproducibility here is relative and never array_equal.
